cases.name: 累积重复与普通计划清理
cases.source:
#+STARTUP: logrepeat logdrawer
* TODO Task
SCHEDULED: <2026-11-01 Sun> DEADLINE: <2026-10-31 Sat +1m -3d>
Body <2026-11-10 Tue +1w>
Inactive [2026-11-10 Tue +1d]

actions.expected:
#+STARTUP: logrepeat logdrawer
* TODO Task
DEADLINE: <2026-12-01 Tue +1m -3d>
:PROPERTIES:
:LAST_REPEAT: [2026-11-11 Wed 12:34]
:END:
:LOGBOOK:
- State "DONE"       from "TODO"       [2026-11-11 Wed 12:34]
:END:
Body <2026-11-17 Tue +1w>
Inactive [2026-11-10 Tue +1d]

#+STARTUP: logrepeat logdrawer
* TODO Task
DEADLINE: <2027-01-01 Fri +1m -3d>
:PROPERTIES:
:LAST_REPEAT: [2026-11-11 Wed 12:34]
:END:
:LOGBOOK:
- State "DONE"       from "TODO"       [2026-11-11 Wed 12:34]
- State "DONE"       from "TODO"       [2026-11-11 Wed 12:34]
:END:
Body <2026-11-24 Tue +1w>
Inactive [2026-11-10 Tue +1d]
